scope: F10, F11, F12 fixes and contract sending verification

fullFlat.mode: Each canonical flat file executed directly in its own Node process, three concurrent files; actual per-case counts retained

mailFocused.boundary: actual source actions, worker and Chromium; migrated local PGlite; external provider controlled IO; no production send or writes

signingFix.implementation: Reject unsupported names before signing RPC, render full source/signature preview before application writes, and reject unsupported new/existing signature names in direct SQL inserts.

boundaries.application: Real action/renderer and real migrated PGlite SQL. Auth/Storage/provider APIs controlled locally. New responsive browser tests use the actual component and controlled action transport.
boundaries.database: Guard checks signature names only, not every arbitrary draft field. App preflight additionally verifies the full unchanged draft and all existing/proposed names.
boundaries.legacy: No old signatures or originals rewritten. NOT VALID constraints preserve historic rows; a bad historic pending signature prevents a new party signature. Already completed unrenderable legacy documents still need explicit font support/recovery.
boundaries.browserEnvironment: Chromium requires normal exec escalation on this executor; sandbox launch SIGTRAP is not a product failure.

signingFix.cleanup: No production data, mails or ads created. Local databases closed by tests. All source edits are available in shared worktree; no commits or deploys made.

liveDiagnostic.doesNotProve: Use of Vercel runtime key in a production customer journey

limitations: Hosted customer contract journey not performed
Unsupported scripts are rejected before app signing, no transliteration or new CJK font
SQL guard applies to signature names, full draft rendering checked in application actions
